column1: # Call targets the exporter rendered as `func_0x<linear address>`.
# The name encodes the target's *linear* address, and every one of them (17 of 18)
# resolves to a named symbol in the model when the address is split at the segment
# The callers pass a segment-like value as the first argument
# (`func_0x0004f32d(0x2379, ...)`), so these are ordinary calls to functions in the
# overlay code segments, not indirect dispatch through a table.
# The problem is that none of the targets is *defined* in the exported tree - the
# export omitted them - so renaming the call sites alone does not close the link.
# They have to be exported first.
